content:
Apple today released the first Mac mini update in nearly two years. The new Mac mini retains the same compact design but comes with all-new M6 and M5 Pro configurations, delivering a substantial performance boost.

The new Mac mini is available for pre-order starting today, with first orders arriving on September 22.

M6 Mac mini

The previous-generation Mac mini used M4 and M4 Pro chips. This time, Apple has changed strategy by equipping the base model with the brand-new M6 chip. The higher-tier model features the M5 Pro chip, which first debuted earlier this year in the MacBook Pro.

The M6 chip inside the Mac mini is Apple's first 2-nanometer processor, featuring a 12-core CPU — two more cores than M4 and M5. Apple emphasises that it delivers "the world's fastest single-threaded performance."

The M6 is Apple's first chip to incorporate all three types of CPU cores simultaneously: 2 super cores, 4 high-performance cores, and 6 efficiency cores. The super cores prioritise the highest single-threaded performance, the high-performance cores are optimised for multi-threaded workloads, while the efficiency cores handle lighter tasks and background operations.

Apple says this combination delivers up to 40% faster multi-threaded performance compared to M4.

On the GPU side, it comes with 12 cores — two more than before. Apple has also brought Neural Accelerators to the base-model Mac mini for the first time, delivering up to 4× faster AI performance and 2× faster graphics performance compared to M4.

The M6 also features a new dual 16-core Neural Engine, which Apple says is up to 2× faster than the previous generation.

The M6 Mac mini starts with 16GB of unified memory, configurable up to 32GB. Memory bandwidth has also been boosted to 170GB/s, faster than M5's 153GB/s and M4's 120GB/s.

Below are some of the performance figures Apple shared for the M6-equipped Mac mini:

  • LLM prompt processing speed with LM Studio is up to 13.5× faster than a Mac mini with M1, and up to 4.8× faster than M4.
  • Microsoft Excel spreadsheet calculations are up to 2.3× faster than a Mac mini with M1, and up to 1.5× faster than M4.
  • In Cyberpunk 2077: Ultimate Edition, gaming performance with ray tracing enabled is up to 2× faster than a Mac mini with M4.

M5 Pro Mac mini

As for the higher-spec Mac mini, it comes with the M5 Pro chip. It can be configured with up to an 18-core CPU, paired with a 20-core GPU. Each GPU core has a Neural Accelerator, along with enhanced shader cores and third-generation ray tracing.

The M5 Pro-equipped Mac mini supports up to 64GB of unified memory, with bandwidth reaching 307GB/s.

Below are the benchmark figures Apple provided for the M5 Pro-equipped Mac mini:

  • LLM prompt processing performance with LM Studio is up to 8.5× faster than a Mac mini with M2 Pro, and up to 4× faster than M4 Pro.
  • Ray-traced rendering performance in Blender is up to 4.5× faster than a Mac mini with M2 Pro, and up to 1.4× faster than M4 Pro.
  • Affinity image processing performance is up to 2.1× faster than a Mac mini with M2 Pro, and up to 1.5× faster than M4 Pro.

More Mac mini specifications

  • Equipped with the Apple N1 chip, supporting Wi-Fi 7 and Bluetooth 6
  • 2.5Gb Ethernet comes standard, upgradable to 10Gb
  • Storage speed has been boosted to up to 2× faster on both models
  • Supports Genlock synchronisation via USB-C, precisely coordinating displays with professional camera shoots.
  • M6 Mac mini: The rear features three Thunderbolt 4 ports, along with HDMI and Ethernet. The front has two USB-C ports supporting USB 3 and a headphone jack.
  • M5 Pro Mac mini: The rear features three Thunderbolt 5 ports, along with HDMI and Ethernet. The front has two USB-C ports supporting USB 3 and a headphone jack.

Pricing and availability of the new Mac mini

Editor's note: In just over a year, the price has gone from $499 to $799. It looks like the Mac mini is getting the same "treatment" as the iPad mini.

The new Mac mini is available for pre-order starting today, with deliveries beginning on September 22. The base model comes with the M6 chip, 256GB of storage, and 16GB of unified memory, priced from $899. The M5 Pro-equipped Mac mini starts from $1,699.

Pre-order the new Mac mini from Apple:

  • Mac mini with M6: from $899
  • Mac mini with M5 Pro: from $1,699

Worth noting is that the base model has seen a $100 price increase compared to the previous generation Mac mini with M4 and M4 Pro.
